pages.title: ORSA PIXIE-2
pages.text: Turns ice into breathable oxygen, using power.

pages.title: Setup
pages.text: Place it in a heated, sealed room and link power with the Binder. Load ice in its one slot.$(br2)$(flavor)Do not name it.$()

pages.title: Output
pages.text: It makes only what the room needs, up to $(bold)4 breathing units$() at $(bold)4 kW$().$(br2)Oxygen gets power before heaters, lights and furnaces.

pages.title: Ice
pages.text: $(li)Ice: one person, one in-game day$(li)Snow: a quarter of that$(li)Packed ice: 9 days$(li)Blue ice: 81 days$(br2)Holds 81 ice-equivalents of water, kept when you harvest it.

pages.title: Keep It Warm
pages.text: $(danger)Below 1°C its water freezes and it stops.$() Warm the room to restart.$(br2)A quarter of its draw becomes heat in the room. Its quiet hum still counts as a vibration.

pages.title: No Power, No Air
pages.text: No power or no water means no oxygen. Bank cells and Cell Docks give finite backup.$(br2)The screen shows output, draw, water and state.

pages.title: Open Rooms
pages.text: Unsealed, it only fills O2 Reservoirs linked directly to it. It never makes open air breathable; full or unlinked tanks leave it idle.
Resealed rooms recover at the normal delay. Airlocks keep their own reserves.
Iron, copper, glass, a bucket and a redstone block. Crafted empty.
